note: English catalogue data. The books themselves are currently published in Russian on Litres.

books.title: The Engineering Model of Reality. Bifurcation Point
books.subtitle: The Blank Rune — a pause between cycles
books.annotation: You are standing still. It is not a dead end. It is a pause — between the old and the new, between what has ended and what has not yet begun. Book 0 is your entry into the system. Just 15 pages. It shows how the 26 books of the series are structured, explains the three times ("what is", "what is happening", "what should be") and gives a simple diagnostic: where you are now and what to do next. No magic. No rituals. Only structure, logic and one question to yourself. Published in Russian.

books.title: The Engineering Model of Reality
books.subtitle: Applied runology for rationalists and managers
books.annotation: This is not a "book of secrets" and not a collection of magic recipes. It is an engineering model of reality. Runes are not only magic — they are a language that describes any process. The author — a software engineer by education who spent his career in sales and management, and now a practising runologist — suggests looking at runes differently: not as "symbols of wealth, protection or love", but as a universal language for describing the stages of any process. Published in Russian.

books.title: The Psychology of Runes
books.subtitle: Runic navigation: how to understand where you are and what to do next
books.annotation: You walk into the kitchen to make coffee. The thought "I want coffee" is ᚠ Fehu (beginning). You look at three packs — ᚢ Uruz (chaos of choice). You take one — ᚦ Thurisaz (choice). You brew it — ᚱ Raidho (first step). You enjoy it — ᚹ Wunjo (joy). Then you wash the cup — ᚺ Hagalaz (the routine of living with a result). 24 runes = 24 states a person can be in. The book teaches you to recognize them without divination — simply by observing yourself. Published in Russian.

books.title: The Key to Mantic Practice
books.subtitle: A 7-day transition from navigation to dialogue with the runes
books.annotation: In the first book you received knowledge: runes are stages of a process, the three times are the matrix. In the second you turned knowledge into a skill: you learned to identify your state without runes. The fourth book — "Mantic Practice Without Illusions" — will demand another level of mastery: the practice of the question. This training is the Key. In 7 days you will turn knowledge into the skills required for an honest dialogue. Published in Russian.

books.title: Mantic Practice Without Illusions
books.subtitle: Divination as diagnostics, not only magic
books.annotation: You have walked the path: Book 1 gave you the system. Book 2 gave you navigation. Now you are ready for dialogue. Book 4 is not about "predictions" or "magic formulas". It is about an honest conversation with the Creator through runes — how to ask questions, hear answers and, most importantly, act on them. Published in Russian.

books.title: Runic Management
books.subtitle: Raidho. The first step through the Futhark: managing projects and teams for those who are stuck
books.annotation: Managing projects, teams and development through the stages of the Futhark. Diagnosing stuckness, taking the first step, practical tools. Published in Russian.

books.title: Kenaz. The Light of Truth
books.subtitle: The illusion of calm and the manifestation of the self
books.annotation: You have already started. You are doing the work. You give it everything you have. But you do not see the result — or it seems there is none. Kenaz is the rune of light, insight and the manifestation of an idea. Published in Russian.

books.title: Runes as a Language: Harmony with the World
books.subtitle: How to live in harmony when everything around demands attention
books.annotation: Gebo — the stage of balance. How to keep connections between the new and the old without burning bridges.

books.title: Runes in the End: Completing the Cycle
books.subtitle: How to finish and start again
books.annotation: Wunjo — the joy of a completed stage. How to mark completion and not get stuck in it.

books.title: Runes in Life: Meaning in Routine
books.subtitle: How not to lose meaning in everyday life
books.annotation: Hagalaz — living with the result. How to see the routine as a mirror of quality, not a catastrophe.

books.title: Runes and Crisis: Signals
books.subtitle: How to hear the signal before it is too late
books.annotation: Nauthiz — the stage of need. How to notice small discomfort before it turns into a crisis.

books.title: Runes and Pause: The Art of Stopping
books.subtitle: The value of stopping and rebooting
books.annotation: Isa — the conscious pause. How to stop without freezing forever.

books.title: Runes and Insight: How Not to Miss the Answer
books.subtitle: How not to miss the answer that has already arrived
books.annotation: Jera — the eureka moment. How to catch and record the insight that comes after the pause.

books.title: Second Chance: The Restart
books.subtitle: How to start again in the same place
books.annotation: Perthro — the second chance. How to restart using old experience instead of starting from zero.

books.title: Runes and Experience: Leaning on the Past
books.subtitle: How the past becomes a foundation for the future
books.annotation: Eihwaz — experience in action. How to use what you already have instead of mining for the new.

books.title: Runes and Protection: Strengthening What You Built
books.subtitle: How to strengthen what you created and keep the results
books.annotation: Algiz — intuition and protection. How to hear the inner voice and protect what has been built.

books.title: Runes and Victory: Realizing Wholeness
books.subtitle: What a completed cycle looks like and how to recognize the victory
books.annotation: Sowilo — experience as form. How to record what the completed cycle made of you.

books.title: Runes and Will: The Brave Step
books.subtitle: How to take a brave step when you are afraid
books.annotation: Tiwaz — the will. How to put all your experience into one decisive movement.

books.title: Rebirth: A New Birth
books.subtitle: How the new is born from the old
books.annotation: Berkana — growth. How to nurture the new without rushing it.

books.title: Runes and Movement: Synchronization
books.subtitle: How to synchronize with the world and move in the flow
books.annotation: Ehwaz — exchange and partnership. How to move together with the world instead of alone.

books.title: Runes and Integration: Becoming the New You
books.subtitle: How to become the new you and be accepted
books.annotation: Mannaz — integration. How to accept your new role and let the world confirm it.

books.title: Runes and Flow: Trusting the Current
books.subtitle: How to trust the current without losing yourself
books.annotation: Laguz — the flow. How to stop controlling and let the water find its way.

books.title: Runes and the Seed: The Potential Within
books.subtitle: What is ripening inside and how to let it manifest
books.annotation: Ingwaz — the seed. How to wait for the result that already exists but has not yet manifested.

books.title: Runes and Legacy: What Remains
books.subtitle: What remains after you and how to pass it on
books.annotation: Othala — the legacy. How to pass the fruits of your cycle to those who come after.

books.title: Runes and Transformation: The Full Cycle
books.subtitle: The full cycle is complete. What next?
books.annotation: Dagaz — transformation. The old is gone, the new has come. The door to a new Fehu.
